# SA-CCR exposure (`sa-ccr` v1)

Regulatory EAD: replacement cost, PFE add-ons by asset class, multiplier.

**Group:** Exposure and capital · **Mnemonic:** `SACCR` · **Identifiers:** `SACCR-…` in `calcId`

Open one with `SACCR <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: sa-ccr
version: 1
description: "Regulatory EAD: replacement cost, PFE add-ons by asset class, multiplier."
match: { kind: sa-ccr, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Exposure and capital · SA-CCR exposure, id: $.calcId }
strip:
  - { label: RC, bind: $.replacementCost, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Add-on, bind: $.addOn, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Multiplier, bind: $.multiplier, fmt: df4 }
  - { label: EAD, bind: $.ead, fmt: compact, emphasis: true }
  - { label: RWA, bind: $.rwa, fmt: compact }
panels:
  - id: addons
    kind: hbar
    title: Add-on by asset class
    key: F2
    rows: $.addOns
    label: assetClass
    value: addOn
    fmt: compact
  - id: hedging
    kind: table
    title: Hedging sets
    rows: $.hedgingSets
    columns:
      - { label: Asset class, bind: "@.assetClass" }
      - { label: Hedging set, bind: "@.hedgingSet" }
      - { label: Effective notional, bind: "@.effectiveNotional", fmt: compact }
      - { label: SF, bind: "@.sf", fmt: pct2 }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.nettingSet, 'netting-set')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
